about: What NPCs fight with beyond the levels in their cache types. Speeds, max hits, attack styles, bonuses and respawn times are the OSRS Wiki infoboxes' (read 2026-10-26), cross-checked with the Wiki's DPS calculator data (weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc monsters.json). Animations are gameval names: attack and death are the NPC's own by name; which of an NPC's block or def animations it defends with is guessed.

npcs.source: OSRS Wiki, Man (ids 3106 to 3109 share the infobox; Al Kharid's man, 3261, is a version of the same page and shares it too, though the DPS calculator gives it 0 defence bonuses)

OSRS Wiki, Al Kharid warrior and the DPS calculator's 3292, read 2026-10-30; the scimitar it holds slashes as a sword does (human_sword_slash; its block guessed). Warriors that join in when one is attacked wait for NPC aggression (the Varrock piece)

OSRS Wiki, Scorpion (Level 14) and the DPS calculator's 3024, read 2026-10-30; it stands and walks with scorpion_update_ready and _walk. The respawn is the page's only infobox's (its level 1 version), so guessed for level 14
OSRS Wiki, Woman (3112 and 3113 are taken to match 3111: the cache gives all three the same levels and bonuses)
OSRS Wiki, Rat (ids 2854, 2855); it stands and walks with mouse_ready and mouse_walk, so it fights with the mouse animations
OSRS Wiki, Imp (id 5007); its water weakness since 25 June 2025

OSRS Wiki, Cow (ids 2790, 2791, 2793); they stand and walk with the cow_update animations; immune to venom (OSRS Wiki, Venom) and to poison, whose timer cows use for mooing (OSRS Wiki, Poison), read 2026-10-30

OSRS Wiki, Cow calf (ids 2792, 2794, 2801); calves stand with cow_just_ready_update and have no attack animation of their own by name, so the cow's are guessed; immune as cows are (guessed: they moo too)

OSRS Wiki, Chicken (ids 1173, 1174), read 2026-10-29; they stand and walk with lore_chicken_ready and lore_chicken_walk, so the chicken_ attack, block and death animations are guessed; immune to poison and venom, as their timer lays eggs (OSRS Wiki, Venom, read 2026-10-30)
OSRS Wiki, Duck (ids 1838, 1839) and Duckling (id 2001), read 2026-10-29; the 241 cache has no duck attack or block animation, so they fight with none

OSRS Wiki, Ram (id 1262; 1263 and 1264 are taken to match it, as the cache gives all three the same levels), read 2026-10-29; rams walk with the sheep_update animations, so the sheep_ fight animations are guessed

OSRS Wiki, Goblin (the Level 2 infobox, ids 3028 to 3044 among them) and the DPS calculator's 3028, read 2026-10-30; ids 3029 to 3036 stand and walk with slice_surface_goblin_squat_ready and _walk, so the slice_surface_goblin unarmed attack, defend and death animations are taken

OSRS Wiki, Giant spider (Level 2, id 3017) and the DPS calculator, read 2026-10-30; it stands and walks with spider_update_ready and _walk, so the spider_update fight animations are taken. It is aggressive on live, which waits for NPC aggression (the Varrock piece)

OSRS Wiki, Giant rat (Level 3, ids 2856 to 2861, and Level 6, 2862 to 2864, share the infobox's speed, style, bonuses and respawn) and the DPS calculator's 2856 and 2862, read 2026-10-30; they stand and walk with giant_rat_update_ready and _walk. They are aggressive on live, which waits for NPC aggression (the Varrock piece)
OSRS Wiki, Frog (Level 5, id 8702) and the DPS calculator, read 2026-10-30; it stands and walks with giant_frog_ready and _walk, so it fights with the giant_frog animations
OSRS Wiki, Big frog (Level 10, id 8701) and Giant frog (Level 13, id 8700), and the DPS calculator, read 2026-10-30

OSRS Wiki, Goblin (the Level 5 infobox, id 3045 among them) and the DPS calculator's 3045, read 2026-10-30; it stands and walks with slice_surface_goblin_squat_ready_spear and _walk_spear, so the spear animations are taken
OSRS Wiki, Unicorn (id 2837) and the DPS calculator, read 2026-10-30; it stands and walks with unicorn_rework_ready and _walk
